scope: Baseline-relative conduit recovery for Gate 3.5 v2

R0_not_recovered.description: System has not returned to baseline-relative tolerance; excess fullness or flooding remains elevated.
R0_not_recovered.criteria: Does not meet R1 or R2 criteria.

R1_functional_recovery.description: System has functionally recovered: PFV/TFV at baseline level, excess fullness within tolerance, no persistent bottlenecks.
criteria: TFV rate within tolerance of baseline

R2_complete_event_recovery.description: Full recovery: all R1 criteria met AND all conduit fullness within baseline MAD band.

PFV_tolerance.source: Contract V2: priority flooding must not increase during recovery window
PFV_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable PFV incremental over stable_recovery_duration

TFV_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable deviation of TFV rate from baseline

excess_fullness_p95_tolerance.source: Baseline fullness P95 + 3*MAD across all conduits
excess_fullness_p95_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable excess fullness P95 for R1

high_excess_conduit_fraction_tolerance.source: 5% of conduits may exceed excess fullness threshold
high_excess_conduit_fraction_tolerance.description: Maximum fraction of conduits with excess_fullness > 0.10

storage_deviation_tolerance.description: Maximum relative deviation of storage volume from baseline

system_volume_slope_tolerance.source: Engineering judgment: near-zero slope for stable system
system_volume_slope_tolerance.description: Maximum absolute system volume slope for recovery

inflow_outflow_imbalance_tolerance.source: 5% imbalance between total inflow and outflow

stable_recovery_duration.description: Minimum continuous window where all recovery criteria must hold

baseline_high_recovered.description: Absolute fullness high but excess fullness near 0; state is stable.

recession_censored.description: Excess fullness still elevated but slope decreasing; not fully recovered at max tail.
recession_censored.criteria: excess_fullness > 0.10 AND recession_slope < 0 AND post_rain_duration < max_tail

persistent_event_bottleneck.description: Excess fullness significant and not decreasing; associated with surcharge or capacity limits.
persistent_event_bottleneck.criteria: excess_fullness > 0.10 AND recession_slope >= 0 OR surcharge OR capacity_limited

numerical_or_structural_audit.description: Adverse/zero slope, anomalous connections, flow-depth inconsistency. INP not modified.
